title: Prove P112 rank-five shortening through common support 46
body:
## Summary

```diff
- Three rank-five P112 residual pieces: sufficient common cut <=45
+ Three rank-five P112 residual pieces: sufficient common cut <=46
```

The new D6 branch uses the actual eight-frame puncture. Its equality budget forces three disjoint twelve-root singleton supports into two axis fibers. After any qualifying orthogonal four-root puncture, the maximum supports in an axis always intersect. The retained A2 branch gives `64 > 63`.

Package `research/p112-rank5-support46/` contains the proof, exact receipts, bounded replay, source pins and Open next questions. Coefficients are arbitrary over every characteristic-zero field. Sharpness, actual TWOSIDE callers, full C5, decoder floor, physical suppliers and kappa remain unclaimed. The selected result is unchanged.

## Evidence

- **Before:** PR3257 stops at 45 because30 perpendicular roots no longer force E6/A2.
  **After:** the D6 normal-plane classification and frame-puncture obstruction close that branch at 46.
- Registered CPython 3.12 replay passes 194,310 axis and 5,334 small-fiber five-spaces, 240 orthogonal punctures, 3,780 planes and their orbit, and 960 reflection-label checks. A separate implementation enumerates 474,672 five-label subsets and recovers the same 240 maximum supports. Seven controls and strict Ruff checks pass.
- Designated read-only internal peer review found no blocker, matched retained source bytes to pinned Git objects and independently ran both scripts from the read-only Git-free export. The singleton-domain clarification was rechecked at its exact final hash. REVIEW.json preserves hashes and limits.
- All 15 final committed package/input byte comparisons and archive integrity pass. The scientific export passed optimized CPython 3.13 replay. Global capacity 12, A2 union 78 and incidence 21 and the Weyl-chamber theorem remain inherited pending dependencies; their historical censuses were not rerun. No human/proof-kernel verification, selected cold replay, Lean or Docker run is claimed.

```sh
python3.12 -W error -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/p112-rank5-support46
```

Base canonical main `463113d675af7410ac91d53a4fed51ec6494eb9a`, revision 6; publication commit `3c4e9dc1a3f1b722bd0db867ecfba17d746816d8`. PR3249 is pinned at `22c7bf316d55e59f381cc9ba833afccc7702fd58` and PR3257 at `1499da8f88c4d0293fe3ae443d0c7fec80f0e2d7`; their proof/receipt bytes are retained for fresh CI without pending Git objects. Credit Nick Petalas, DreamingOfClouds/PR3154 and the root-simplex/E8/P112 lineage including joaqcoo. The concurrent mixed ranks 5,5,6 at cut38 work has a different predicate and is not a premise here.

[Canonical investigation](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/3156#discussioncomment-19003544). Submission overlap covers 311 open PRs and 2,101 Discussion records with complete pagination through 2026-10-17T20:02Z; closed work and mathematical implications are not exhaustively searched.

## Merge Danger

**Door:** two-way

**Blast Radius:** isolated

One new opt-in research package. Frozen sources, shared tools and selected records are unchanged. Archival retention would not admit the complete decoder or multiplication theorem.
